name: ukb_vep_applet
title: VEP Annotation Applet
summary: WGS annotation applet. Takes a chromosome name and a list of VCFs. Runs a bunch of pre-defined annotations. Creates TSV annotation files.

inputSpec.name: vep_vcfs
inputSpec.label: VCF list
inputSpec.help: Input file ID (hash file-xxxxx). Contains a list of vcf file IDs or full paths, one per line

inputSpec.name: vep_timeout
inputSpec.label: VEP run time out
inputSpec.help: The time allowed (in seconds) before the annotation job is killed. Prevents stalling.

inputSpec.name: vep_forks
inputSpec.label: VEP forks
inputSpec.help: Option passed to VEP to set the number of forks

inputSpec.name: vep_buffer
inputSpec.label: VEP buffer
inputSpec.help: Passed to vep to determine the buffer size. Larger numbers load more variants in memory for faster processing

inputSpec.name: vep_ver
inputSpec.label: Version
inputSpec.help: VEP version. Used to find correct docker and data directories; currently preset to 114. Don't change for now

outputSpec.name: vep_log
outputSpec.label: Log files
outputSpec.help: Job log: a text file with summaries and concatenated STDERR files. Output list: one txt file per validated input VCF showing the input and output file IDs

outputSpec.name: vep_out
outputSpec.label: Output files
outputSpec.help: One tsv file per validated input VCF
